# ScriptNbtList

*Common*

NBT list: indexed values of one type, from `scram.nbtList()` or read from an NBT compound.

## Methods

### getMinecraftNbtList {#getminecraftnbtlist}

::: member

**Returns** `NbtList` — the Minecraft list this wrapper changes, for Java code

:::

### isCompound {#iscompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — false: a list is not a compound

:::

### isList {#islist}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true

:::

### stringify {#stringify}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the list as SNBT text, like `[1,2,3]`

:::

### isEmpty {#isempty}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether it holds no values

:::

### size {#size}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — number of values it holds

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

**Returns** [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) — deep copy; changing it does not change this one

:::

### combine {#combine}

::: member

Adds copies of the items of another list to the end of this one, if both hold the same type; otherwise nothing changes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | list to copy from; other values are ignored |

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`Nbt`](/scripting/common/nbt/Nbt) | other NBT value, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both hold equal values of the same kind

:::

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | position, from 0 |

:::
